asr.full_text: Welcome to the Mirror Trading International opportunity. Mirror Trading International is a trading and networking company founded in April 2019. Johan Stainberg, the CEO and founder, is from Polokwani in South Africa. The trading system of Mirror Trading International utilizes advanced trading software with built-in artificial intelligence that dynamically adjusts to trading and market conditions. To join the club, you will need your own Bitcoin wallet and you will need to register with Mirror Trading International and have the minimum of 100$ in Bitcoin for your membership. In Mirror Trading International there are no packages. Your membership continues as long as you keep a minimum balance of 100$ in your club account. Your membership is always in Bitcoin. You earn Bitcoin daily and when the price of Bitcoin rises so will the value of your membership. The system is fully automated and you can sit back and relax and receive your daily statements detailing the results of the trades for the day. Withdrawal requests will be sent to your Bitcoin wallet within 48 hours. That summarizes the passive part of the opportunity. And as a member you will Withdrawal requests will be sent to your Bitcoin wallet within 48 hours. That summarizes the passive part of the opportunity and as a member you will receive bonuses from the trading activities. No recruiting is necessary to receive passive bonuses. Should you wish to refer your friends you will earn a 10% referral bonus for every member who joins you and also for any amounts they add over and above the original investment. The business opportunity with miracle trading international financial freedom is no longer just a dream all bonuses come from daily trading results and is therefore 100% financially sustainable the multi-level marketing system of merit trading international is simple consists of a 10% referral bonus and a 20% binary profit sharing bonus. Daily bonuses are divided as follows, 40% to you the member, 30% to the trading system, 10% to MirrorTrading International for administration and to pay the referral bonuses, and 20% to the binary profit-sharing bonuses. The 20% comes from the daily bonuses, and the binary bonuses are paid weekly. Merit Trading International is a real company, and just like any company, if there are no trading profits, there can be no bonuses. To qualify for binary bonuses, you will also need a minimum membership of $200, and you will need to a minimum membership of $200 and you will need to have personally recruited one new member into your left and one into your right leg. The Binary Profit Sharing bonuses are awarded according to your level of membership. With a membership from $200 to $999, you will receive bonuses up to 10 levels deep in the binary. A membership of $1000 to $4,999 you will receive bonuses up to 20 levels deep. • $5,000 to $9,999 receive bonuses up to 30 levels deep. • $10,000 plus will receive bonuses on infinite levels of the binary structure in your weakest leg. • The third person you personally introduce will become spillover for one of the people you introduced before, as you can only place in your left and right side. Spillover will also occur if your sponsor or team members above you introduce people into a leg. 20% of the bonuses from the week's trading will be shared according to the value of your smallest binary team. from the week's trading will be shared according to the value of your smallest Binary Team. The Binary profit sharing bonuses are paid weekly and create a real, re-occurring passive income. Mirror Trading International is the opportunity we have all been looking for! Join the Club today, build your business and begin the journey to financial freedom. For more information please contact the person who sent you this video. Withdrawing your Bitcoin from Mirror Trading International. The objective of Mirror Trading International is to grow your Bitcoin. The only way your Bitcoin will grow is when it is in trade. Every week trading starts on Monday at 1 minute past midnight and ends on a Friday at 1 minute before midnight . The statement run takes place at the end of every trading day and all withdrawal requests are submitted to the broker just after the statement run is complete. These withdrawal requests are then finalized and you will receive your Bitcoin a couple of hours later. What happens if you request a withdrawal on the weekend? No trading takes place on the weekend, therefore the brokers are not at work and your Bitcoin is safely resting in the trading account. So bear in mind that a request made on a Saturday and Sunday will be processed at the end of the trading day on Monday, and your withdrawal request will be paid to you on Tuesday. If you would like to be completely strategic and get your Bitcoin to work to the absolute maximum, only make a withdrawal on a Monday to ensure you still get the full day's trading bonus from the Bitcoin you wish to withdraw. Talking of withdrawals, let's look at the process of withdrawing your Bitcoin from the pool account. In your back office you will have a trading pool balance. Remember that if you have qualified for the weekly binary bonus that you will need to keep at least $200 in your trading pool to continue getting binary bonuses weekly. Before withdrawing you will need to go to the wallets section in the menu, then click on internal fund transfer. The internal fund transfer screen will appear. You will need to choose the type of transfer you are wanting to do. In this case you will choose the pool to income wallet option. fill in the amount in Bitcoin which you withdraw and enter your transaction password. this is the same as your login password and click Submit. A new screen will appear and you may confirm the transfer. A screen will appear confirming that the transfer was successful. Confirm in your back office that your Income Wallet has the balance you want to withdraw. Then click wallet withdrawal in the Wallet section on the left-hand menu. Confirm in your back office that your income wallet has the balance you want to withdraw. Then click Wallet withdrawal in the Wallet section on the left hand menu. When you get the New screen, click New Request, click Here. The request form will show you the various balances you have including the amount in the income wallet you wish to withdraw. Enter the amount you want to withdraw and carefully copy and paste your Bitcoin address to where the Bitcoin will be paid. Once this has done, click submit. A new screen will appear, asking you to confirm the withdrawal. You can click submit again. You will now get a notification saying, Withdrawal request sent, wait for processing. If you click on withdrawal request again, you will be able to see your withdrawal request and its current status should you have any further questions Thank you.

textual.observation: The video promotes a Bitcoin membership requiring registration and a minimum $100 Bitcoin balance, while promising daily Bitcoin earnings, increasing membership value if Bitcoin rises, and withdrawals within 48 hours.

evidence.quote: you will need to register with Mirror Trading International and have the minimum of 100$ in Bitcoin for your membership
You earn Bitcoin daily and when the price of Bitcoin rises so will the value of your membership.
Withdrawal requests will be sent to your Bitcoin wallet within 48 hours.

textual.context: Promotional opportunity presentation; the source describes the stated terms as a passive-income opportunity.
textual.potential_relevance: A promised daily return and 48-hour withdrawal outcome are linked to registering and maintaining a minimum Bitcoin balance.
textual.limitations: These records do not establish whether the trading system, company, returns, or withdrawals are genuine or achievable.

textual.observation: The promotion describes referral and binary profit-sharing bonuses, including a 10% referral bonus and eligibility for binary bonuses after recruiting members on both sides of the structure and maintaining a minimum $200 membership.

evidence.quote: you will earn a 10% referral bonus for every member who joins you and also for any amounts they add over and above the original investment.
personally recruited one new member into your left and one into your right leg.
The 20% comes from the daily bonuses, and the binary bonuses are paid weekly.

textual.context: The source presents the referral and binary structure as part of a business opportunity; it separately states that recruiting is not necessary for passive bonuses.
textual.potential_relevance: Bonus payments are linked to recruiting members, maintaining specified membership amounts, and participating in a multi-level binary structure.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish whether members were recruited, whether bonuses were paid, or whether the described structure complied with any external rules.

textual.observation: The withdrawal instructions direct a participant to move Bitcoin from a pool account to an income wallet, enter a transaction password, copy a Bitcoin address, and submit the withdrawal request.

evidence.quote: you will need to go to the wallets section in the menu, then click on internal fund transfer
fill in the amount in Bitcoin which you withdraw and enter your transaction password.
carefully copy and paste your Bitcoin address to where the Bitcoin will be paid.
You will now get a notification saying, Withdrawal request sent, wait for processing.

textual.context: Operational withdrawal tutorial presented within the promotional opportunity; the source says the transaction password is the same as the login password.
textual.potential_relevance: A promised withdrawal is connected to transferring Bitcoin within the account, entering an account password, and providing an external Bitcoin address.
textual.limitations: The records do not show whether any password or Bitcoin address was actually submitted, whether funds were transferred, or whether the destination address was controlled by the participant.

visual.observation: Promotional slides state that "all bonuses come from daily trading results" and show a "$200" personal membership with one personally introduced person on each side; another slide describes a third introduced person as "spillover."
visual.context: Promotional presentation explaining a binary membership and recruitment structure.
visual.potential_relevance: The slides visibly link a financial bonus or return claim with a $200 membership payment and recruiting people into left and right positions.
visual.limitations: These frames do not establish how bonuses are calculated, whether payments are made, or whether members receive funds.

visual.observation: A slide instructs viewers to "Make a withdrawal on a Monday" so they "still get the full 7 days trading bonus" from the Bitcoin they want to withdraw.
visual.context: Presented as a "Best Strategy" instruction within promotional material.
visual.potential_relevance: A specific withdrawal-timing instruction is explicitly tied to retaining a promised trading bonus.
visual.limitations: The frame does not establish that the bonus exists, will be paid, or that any withdrawal was completed.

visual.observation: Back-office screens show an internal fund transfer or withdrawal form with a Bitcoin amount, a transaction-password field, a Bitcoin address, and a Submit button.
visual.context: Account-interface demonstration labeled "Back Office" and "Withdrawal Request Form."
visual.potential_relevance: The demonstrated process includes a crypto transfer or withdrawal step, entry of a transaction password, and a destination address alongside the video's bonus and withdrawal messaging.
visual.limitations: The sampled frames do not establish that the form was submitted, that any transfer occurred, or that the displayed address or amount was valid; sparse sampling does not prove a click or redirect.

textual_context_notes.observation: The source includes a qualification that bonuses depend on trading profits and distinguishes passive bonuses from binary bonuses that require recruitment.

evidence.quote: if there are no trading profits, there can be no bonuses.
No recruiting is necessary to receive passive bonuses.

visual_context_notes.observation: The material uses Mirror Trading International branding, including a "Become a Member" button on a webpage and the same logo on presentation slides.
One presentation slide frames the objective as "Grow your Bitcoin" and shows Bitcoin imagery.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes depositing at least 100 dollars in Bitcoin for passive daily earnings and presents the opportunity as financially sustainable and a path to financial freedom. It also encourages recruitment into left and right legs, with bonuses extending multiple levels deep and higher membership amounts tied to broader qualification. The video directly calls viewers to join the club and build the business.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S06 is the primary subtype because the promoted earnings structure includes personally recruiting members into left and right legs, spillover, binary bonuses, and payouts extending through multiple levels. S03 is separately supported by the promoted passive daily Bitcoin earnings from funds held in a trading pool, while S02 is supported by the claimed automated AI trading system linked to funded membership and returns.
